title: Director at Global IT Services Integrator Expects Snowflake-Related Business to Grow 14%–15% in 2027
expert: Managing director and chief AI architect at a global IT services integrator (Fortune 500 clients)
verdict: The integrator's Snowflake business grew 15%–16% y/y in Aug–Oct, slightly ahead of plan [[1 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse17311&hl=fse17311,fse18242,fse20776&page=2), with deal sizes moving from $1–1.5 million to $2–2.5 million as Cortex agents drive back-office automation [[8 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse12383&hl=fse12383&page=2).

Demand / orders: 🟢 Snowflake practice +15%–16% y/y (Aug–Oct), slightly above plan, vs the Cleveland global SI's +40% in 1H26 (SB #45418): slower but solid. → Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration) → [[1 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse17311&hl=fse17311,fse18242,fse20776&page=2)

🟡 14%–15% in 2027 vs 18%–19% in 2026 (estimate) as agentic excitement normalizes. [[10 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse24455&hl=fse24455,fse24857&page=2)

🟢 70%–75% of clients on Cortex AI, ~40% on Cortex Code, vs KeyBanc's ~50% CoCo adoption of active users (SB #61004): consistent. → Tenet 2 (AI second engine) ↑ [[9 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse40230&hl=fse40230,fse42282&page=2)
Pricing & margins: 🟢 deal sizes $1–1.5 million → $2–2.5 million and ACV +7%–8% y/y (estimate) on new AI modules; first read. → Tenet 2 (AI second engine) ↑ [[8 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse12383&hl=fse12383&page=2) [[7 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse28249&hl=fse28249&page=2)
Competition & share: 🟡 Python-first customers pick Databricks as primary AI platform; Snowflake wins on data gravity, consistent with Cleveland's both-win view (SB #45419). → Tenet 3 (control point) → [[12 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse9063&hl=fse9063,fse9262,fse11403&page=2) [[6 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-268754&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse8230&hl=fse8230,fse9831,fse10171&page=2)

changes: Practice +15%–16% y/y (Aug–Oct) vs Cleveland global SI +40% in 1H26 (SB #45418): slower.
Cortex Code on ~40% of clients vs KeyBanc ~50% of active users (SB #61004): consistent (different base).
First read on ACV growth (+7%–8%) and deal-size step-up; no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (core re-acceleration): → — channel growth +15%–16% and slightly above plan, moderating to 14%–15% in 2027.
Tenet 2 (AI second engine): ↑ — 70%–75% of clients on Cortex AI; ACV +7%–8% from AI modules.
Tenet 3 (governed-data control point): → — Databricks wins Python-first and custom-agent work; Snowflake wins where data already sits.
